name: Peninsula Hot Springs Glamping
signature: Eco lodges and glamping pods inside the Peninsula Hot Springs precinct  -  wake up, walk thirty seconds to the Spa Dreaming Centre
editorNote:
The glamping-and-lodges precinct at Peninsula Hot Springs is the closest thing the Peninsula has to a genuine wellness retreat stay. The canvas pods sit within the hot springs grounds itself  -  not a hotel nearby, not a separate resort, but physically inside the precinct  -  which means that the thirty-second walk to the Spa Dreaming Centre first thing in the morning, before any day guests have arrived, becomes the most memorable part of the stay.

Ten tents across garden-view, lake-view, and secluded pavilion settings. Heated geothermal concrete floors, king beds, private decks, and full all-site bathing access including the Spa Dreaming Centre. 16 and over (not 18+). No dogs. The Eco Lodges at the same site are the enclosed version of the same proposition for when canvas is not the point.

Book a two-night package if you can. Arrive mid-afternoon, bathe at dusk, eat dinner at the on-site Amphitheatre restaurant, and go back to the pools before bed. One of the Peninsula's essential overnight experiences.
